summary.text: Bobby Charles, a Republican lawyer who grew up in Wayne, Maine, lost the November 3, 2026 election for governor of Maine to Hannah Pingree.
He served as Assistant Secretary of State for International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs from 2003 to 2005 and later founded a consulting firm in Washington, D.C.

paragraphs.text: Charles grew up in Wayne, Maine, and attended Maranacook High School.
He earned a B.A. from Dartmouth College in 1982, an M.A. from Oxford in 1984 and a J.D. from Columbia Law School in 1987.
He served as U.S. Assistant Secretary of State for International Narcotics and Law Enforcement Affairs from 2003 to 2005.
Charles later founded The Charles Group, a consulting firm based in Washington, D.C.
He was the Republican nominee for governor of Maine in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He received 37.4% of the vote to Hannah Pingree's 54.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
